googlebot.purpose: Googlebot itself — the crawler that builds the search index

special-crawlers.purpose: AdsBot, APIs-Google and the other special-case crawlers

user-triggered-fetchers.purpose: fetches a user asked for, such as Search Console live tests

note: Counted from Google's own published JSON at https://developers.google.com/static/search/apis/ipranges/, which carries its own creationTime — the lists change, so the date matters. The spot check resolves one address from each of the first few published Googlebot ranges through Scout's reverse-then-forward DNS check; those addresses are Googlebot by Google's definition, so a failure would be our bug. It is a smoke test against real DNS and NOT a rate: six addresses cannot be published as a percentage, and the sample is small deliberately because each check costs two lookups on somebody else's resolver.
